gloss: all ages; ancient and modern times

definitions.gloss: all ages; ancient and modern; throughout history
definitions.explanation: Literary noun combining {古|こ} (old) and {今|こん} (now), referring to all eras from antiquity to the present. Almost always used in fixed expressions or titles rather than as a free-standing word.

examples.japanese: {古今|ここん}⟦{東西|とうざい}→東西：04554_touzai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{名作|めいさく}→名作：11869_meisaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}めた→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧。
examples.english: We have gathered masterpieces from all times and places.

examples.japanese: {古今|ここん}{無双|むそう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{英雄|えいゆう}→英雄：14117_eiyuu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: He is said to be a hero without equal in any age.

examples.japanese: {古今|ここん}⟦{東西|とうざい}→東西：04554_touzai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{問|と}わ→問う：02299_tou⟧ず、⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{愛|あい}→愛：02370_ai⟧⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦{語|かた}り→語る：01930_kataru⟧⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧てきた。
examples.english: Regardless of era or culture, people have always talked about love.

notes:
Literary compound of {古|こ} (old) + ⟦{今|こん}→今〜：03952_kon⟧ (now). In modern Japanese it appears almost exclusively in set phrases and classical titles, not as a stand-alone noun.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {古今|ここん}⟦{東西|とうざい}→東西：04554_touzai⟧: all times and places (everywhere, in every era)
- {古今|ここん}⟦{東西|とうざい}→東西：04554_touzai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{問|と}わ→問う：02299_tou⟧ず: regardless of time or place
- {古今|ここん}{無双|むそう}: unmatched in any era
- {古今|ここん}{和歌集|わかしゅう}: the Kokin Wakashū (10th-century poetry anthology)

REGISTER:
Formal and literary. Common in essays, speeches, and historical writing; rare in casual conversation, where ⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{今|いま}まで→今まで：11546_imamade⟧ is more natural.
